jobs_results.title: DevOps and Platform Engineer, Terraform and Kubernetes (AWS)
jobs_results.description:
DevOps and Platform Engineer, Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS

At DataBeacon our mission is to revolutionize the aviation industry using a modern technology stack, open source technologies and lean architectures.

Our first product is SimpliFID, an Aerodrome Flight Information Service (AFIS) that covers most functionalities of a radar system at a fraction of the costs. Built in Rust, Python and TypeScript, it sources data from ADB-S and Mode-S Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) systems over Asterix CAT021 Surveillance Data Exchange protocol.

Currently, SimpliFID is being certified and deployed in 6 small to mid-sized airports, with another 15+ planned for 2025+. Our main focus is on scalability, security and additional internal projects around real-time data services.

In anticipation to the exciting challenges ahead, we look forward to extend our engineering team with an exceptional DevOps and Platform Engineer focused on Kubernetes (EKS) and Terraform on AWS.

What would you do:
•... manage DataBeacon platform using K8s manifests and kustomize + Helm,
• provision of infrastructure using Terraform,
• work with a small and highly motivated, skilled team of engineers,
• participate in the company technical decisions and roadmap,
• space to experiment and try-out new exciting technologies,
• have minimal administrative overhead and the possibility to create a real impact,

You must have:
• at least 2+ of professional experience in DevOps, automation, CD/CI, observability and reliability,
• at least 1+ years of experience with AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
• experience with IaC using Terraform and terragrunt,
• have a good command of English and good communication skills,
• be located in Madrid or surroundings.

Nice to have:
• fundamentals of operating systems, databases and networking,
• experience as database administrator or linux OS in general,
• proficiency in Python and/or Rust programing languages,
• professional experience in highly regulated sectors,
• affinity for aviation in general.

What we offer:
• a total of 25 vacation days, including Christmas' and New Year’s eves,
• hybrid and work-from-home policies tailored to your needs,
• a beautiful office in the center of Madrid, near Alonso Martinez,
• yearly budget for continuous learning, conferences, books, courses,
• a fairly generous compensation, reviewed yearly, and a personal growth plan.

If this position and our mission resonates with you, we would be excited to hear from you

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
**Who are you?**
- Capable of automating the entire CI/CD pipelines and cycles.
- Can automate configuration management repetitive tasks.
- Think about security first and make sure that the best safe practices are applied.
- Knowledge of how highly available systems work.
- Know Agile concepts and principles.
• *What makes you successful?**
- Experience working on Linux based infrastructure.
- Familiarity with networking concepts and security practices behind it like ufw and firewalld.
- Working experience with Git.
- Two years working with cloud workloads (Azure/AWS).
- Working knowledge with IaC like Ansible.
- Scripting skills in Bash or Python.
- Working experience with CI tools like Jenkins, Github/Gitlab pipelines and Tekton.
- Working experience with Helm and GitOps tools like ArgoCD and Kustomize.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
- Working knowledge with monitoring systems ( Grafana, Prometheus).
• *What is considered as a plus?**
- CKAD certification.
- Have worked with... messaging systems like (RabbitMQ, NATS) and SQL/NoSQL databases like Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL.
- Good knowledge of HA proxy and Nginx web servers.
- Have been part of the on-call rotation schedule

jobs_results.title: DevOps Cloud
jobs_results.description:
TMC Spain is looking for DevOps Cloud professionals. Would you like to be an Employeneur? If you have excellent problem solving and critical thinking, you are ready for to support our team. Join us!

Depending on your develop experience, expertise and affinity, your scope of activity may be different: Automotive, Aeronautical & Defence, Banking and Services companies. You’ll use your knowledge to support specialized teams consisting of several technical disciplines at the customer’s premises.

Your activities will mainly focus on the design and development for the architecture, implementation and management of the operational infrastructure and the software release processes. It’s crucial that you have a good overview of potential software design methodologies, operating systems and programming languages and that you are able to motivate this to others.
| What do we expect from you?

Perfectly fluent in Spanish and good level of English, you have a BSc. Or MSc. Degree in Computer... Sciences, Informatics or similar education with several years of experience in software. During your studies or through professional experience you have gained expertise in one or more of the following topics:
• Work experience developing with infrastructure as code (IaC) technologies such as Terraform or Ansible.
• Knowledge in Containerization and orchestration technologies: Docker, Kubernetes.
• Experience in Azure DevOps, Ansible, yaml-pipelines, Helm, build agents, scripting (bash, python).
• Experience in code versioning and continuous integration (Bitbucket, Maven, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc…).
• Implementation of cloud-native architecture vision using either Azure or AWS.
• Build and deployment tools such as Git, Gradle, Maven.
• Design and maintain an agile release concept for IaC, Microservices and data.
• Align with Security lead on quality controls.
• Experience working in Agile projects applying methodologies (Jira, Confluence, Bamboo, etc…).

In addition to these technical skills developed through your industry experience, you have developed strong soft skills such as good oral and written communicative skills, and a team player attitude. Serious motivation for the Employeneurship model of TMC is also required.

Your profile matches these expectations? Let’s talk about your plan!
| What can you expect from TMC?

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to their clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster changing technological world.

At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career.

As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

We are truly unique thanks to our Employeneurship model which is a true innovation for the High Technology consulting business. It is the business relationship of the 21th century for high skilled technical professionals. It is built around 5 main pillars:
• You will have a permanent employment contract, offering you stability and security
• You will get to know your market value and have a share in the profit your work generates thanks to the individual profit sharing
• We will support you with a one-on-one coaching and trainings designed to help you develop your entrepreneurial skills
• The competence cells structure, provides you with a strong meaningful and relevant network
• The entrepreneurial lab: a playground for new ideas and a potential launching for start-ups

TMC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Is TMC a perfect fit for you? We’d love to hear from you.
Let your network know what’s going on.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?
• Experiencia demostrable como DevOps y realizando funciones de Release Manager de al menos 2 años.

• Implementar prácticas de DevOps incluyendo CI/CD y gestión de pipelines.
• Experiencia en Azure Databricks y Data Factory BD Synapse y CosmoDB.

• Contrato indefinido con banda salarial a negociar (Entre 32 y 40K B/A)

Si tienes interés en una gran oportunidad como ésta ¡inscríbete! ¡Queremos conocerte!

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Devops
jobs_results.description:
Desde Prosegur buscamos un/a Ingeniero de Devops para nuestro equipo de soporte con gran conocimiento en Azure. La vacante se ubicará en Madrid, con modelo híbrido de trabajo (compaginando teletrabajo con asistencia a la oficina).

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?
• Gestión de las herramientas de CI/CD
• Implementación de mejoras en los flujos y procesos.
• Soporte a los diferentes equipos de desarrollo para la implementación de los flujos devops.
• Colaboración con todos los equipos de Gobierno Cloud de Prosegur

¿Qué buscamos de ti?
• Grado en ingeniería informática y/o similar.
• FP en sistemas informáticos y/o similar.
• Conocimientos en Jenkins y Azure Devops.
• Conocimientos de automatización (scripting).
• Conocimiento de gestión de herramientas del flujo de desarrollo.
• Deseable conocimiento en Terraform, AWS, Azure, etc.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Formar parte de un equipo internacional (con presencia en 32 países).
• Trabajar en un entorno dinámico con un excelente ambiente... laboral.
• Participar en proyectos estratégicos y disruptivos.
• Crecer profesionalmente atendiendo a un plan carrera personalizado.
• Acceder a un plan formativo de primer nivel gracias a la Universidad Corporativa de Prosegur.
• Disponer de flexibilidad horaria y de interesantes beneficios sociales a través de Reflex.
• Disfrutar de nuestro Programa Global de Bienestar.
• Colaborar con nuestra Fundación para crear una sociedad más justa.
• Dar vida a tus ideas en nuestro Programa Global de Innovación e Intraemprendimiento.

Nuestro Propósito y nuestros Valores

“Cuidar de las personas y empresas para hacer del mundo un lugar más seguro, manteniéndonos a la vanguardia de la innovación” es lo que nos motiva desde hace más de 40 años.

Y lo hacemos utilizando las tecnologías más punteras (IA, IoT, Data Science, Blockchain, etc.) para ofrecer soluciones disruptivas a través de nuestras cinco líneas de negocio: Security, Cash, Alarms, Cipher y AVOS.

Nuestros más de 150.000 profesionales presentes en 31 países nos han convertido en un referente en el sector de la seguridad y nos ayudan cada día a mantener y compartir nuestros valores: Nos importan las personas, pensamos en positivo y somos imparables.

¿Y tú? ¿Te sientes identificad@ con nuestro propósito? Súmate a nuestro Team of Teams aplicando a esta oferta y comienza tu aventura con nosotros

Software and devops engineer in artificial intelligence

We are looking for a professional with a developer profile and interest in artificial intelligence to join the R&D team of the language technologies department, who is proactive, eager to learn new technologies and used to work autonomously..

Candidates must have:
• Back-end development: C/C++ and Python.
• Golang knowledge will be an asset
• RESTful API communication interfaces and microservices
• Docker virtualization practice
• CI/CD continuous integration and distribution experience

jobs_results.title: Azure Devops
jobs_results.description:
¿Estás abierto a asumir nuevos retos como Azure Devops en una empresa SaaS? 💥

Somos Voxel, una empresa líder mundial en el sector Turismo & Horeca que ofrecemos soluciones en facturación electrónica, pagos electrónicos y digitalización de la cadena de suministro. 💰

Como Devops Engineer, tendrás un papel crucial en nuestra nueva iniciativa estratégica para mejorar la escalabilidad de nuestra plataforma. Serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar estrategias técnicas dentro del equipo que aseguren que nuestra infraestructura esté a la altura del crecimiento constante de la empresa.

▶Buscamos un Devops Engineer altamente motivado y con experiencia en tecnologías de Azure y otros entornos similares. Deberías tener:
• Capacidad demostrada en diseñar e implementar infraestructura segura en la nube con Azure.
• Enfocarte de manera innata en soluciones basadas en la nube.
• Conocer y poseer experiencia con herramientas de análisis.
• Experiencia trabajando en entornos de alta... disponibilidad y con grandes cargas de trabajo.
• Tener una destacada habilidad de comunicación y para trabajar en equipo.
• Profundo entendimiento de componentes de la nube e infraestructura (servidores, almacenamiento, redes, datos y aplicaciones) para entregar arquitecturas y diseños completos de infraestructura en la nube.
• Experiencia en virtualización y tecnologías de contenedores, como Docker, así como en la gestión de registros privados, y en la administración y resolución de problemas con contenedores, Kubernetes y Nutanix.
• Conocimientos en arquitecturas Hub & Spoke y una profunda comprensión sobre redes.
• Experiencia en automatización utilizando herramientas como Terraform y Ansible, y en herramientas de control de versiones como Git.
• Habilidades avanzadas en administración de sistemas Linux.
• Familiaridad con prácticas de CI/CD, análisis DAST/SAST, automatización de controles de seguridad y mejores prácticas en todo el ciclo de desarrollo de software, incluyendo codificación segura, autenticación, control de acceso, monitoreo y cifrado.
• Experiencia llevando a cabo revisiones de seguridad y un profundo entendimiento de los conceptos de seguridad.
• Conocimientos y experiencia en entornos regulados como ISO 27001 y PCI DSS.
• Habilidad para influir y guiar a otros ingenieros.
• Es recomendable tener experiencia en refactorización, entornos CQRS, microservicios y Jenkins.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Opinov8 is a technology service provider, with an Opinion in Innovation , we engage with our clients at any stage in their product engineering and innovation goals, with solutions being mainly collaborative and outcome-driven. We are driven by delivering value , for our clients, through technological innovation .

We are a young energetic and dynamically agile company and the team behind Opinov8 are software industry veterans. We are ambitious on our own and on our client’s behalf and we do not look at a client engagement as a project, we are in it to help our clients build sustainable products, platforms, and businesses.

Our core values and what we look for in our Opinov8rs:

You are Collaborative - which is a key component to being successful in distributed environments.

You are Innovative - it is a requirement that we innovate, as individuals and as a company.

Be Adventurous - courageous people are adventurous, we are hiring and nurturing this quality.

Always Respectful ... remember if you don’t respect others they will not respect you.

Inherently Intelligent - it goes without saying we are all intelligent in our own way.

Ultimately Responsible - being responsible is a core personality trait that is needed for us and our clients’ success and ultimately a happy work environment.

Join us as a DevOps Engineer and seize an exciting career opportunity. If you're passionate about optimizing software delivery and operations, this role lets you work on a platform/product team in a top-tier marketing consultancy. It's a chance for growth and impact in an organization leading in high-impact digital marketing, serving world-renowned brands.

What will your day look like?

As our new DevOps Engineer, you will join a team of highly skilled and dedicated individuals responsible for delivering solutions and services to our large international client base.

Your specific responsibilities and tasks encompass:

Assisting in building a high-performance team of DevOps engineers focused on delivering automation and scalability for the platform.

Developing hands-on implementations involving IaC, Kubernetes, and cloud services (Azure and GCP) using GitFlow, Azure DevOps, and Terraform.

Driving innovation, optimization, and automation of our SDLC and CI/CD processes.

Providing support to our QA engineering team in their efforts to automate testing.

Implementing appropriate monitoring of endpoints, services, and systems to facilitate site reliability management and enhance RCA for improved incident resolution.

Collaborating closely with our development teams to identify areas for improvement.

What do you bring to the table?

You are passionate about DevOps and fueled by the process of optimizing software delivery and the team responsible for it. You are a fast learner and embrace change when it is required to achieve goals set by the business and the team you work in.

It is important that you work comfortably in either Java, C#, TypeScript or Python and the command line using either Linux Shell or PowerShell.

More specifically, you have:

+3 years of hands-on experience with building and maintaining cloud IT infrastructure.

+3 years of hands-on experience with SDLC and CI/CD processes.

+3 years of experience with a major programming language.

Solid experience with Microsoft Azure.

Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

Ideally you also have:

Professional experience of working with Kubernetes in production settings.

Experience with Umbraco CMS or other CMS systems.

Knowledge of marketing and maybe even marketing automation systems.

LET'S WORK TOGETHER

Join our global team of innovative technologies and creative thinkers

Sourcing strategy / Full recruitment cycle / Effective communication
Let us innov8 with you
